summary: Citizen expresses concern about potential elimination of E-Rate program, emphasizing its importance for rural and urban Alaska schools and libraries.

claims.argument: Continued support of the program is essential if we want to build on advancements and meet evolving needs
claims.evidence_quote: Funding has already been cut to many federal programs supporting schools and libraries, and that funding has in turn affected state money available for schools. Schools in our state are in crisis and if further funding that supports internet access is cut, I am concerned that schools will be left without internet access at all.
